description.en: Zotero literature skill for DeepSeek Harness: finds papers through OpenAlex, tracks new work in a field, ranks core papers, manages items (tags, collections, duplicate checks), builds multi-level folders by research direction, batch-reads a corpus into notes, charts the research landscape, and surfaces open gaps. It also exports BibTeX, inserts citations into LaTeX or Markdown drafts, and imports a ranked daily digest of new papers. Standard-library Python only, talking to the official local Zotero API and the Zotero Connector; writes need a one-time authorization. Adapted from OpenAI's MIT-licensed Zotero plugin (openai/plugins); daily auto-import scheduling is Windows-only.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 Zotero 文献技能：通过 OpenAlex 找文献、追前沿、筛核心论文，管理条目（标签、归集、查重），按研究方向与类型/方法/数据组建多层文件夹，把一批论文整理成阅读笔记，提炼脉络并发现空白，另可导出 BibTeX、给 LaTeX 或 Markdown 草稿插入引用、按日自动收录新论文。纯 Python 标准库，只走 Zotero 官方本地 API 与 Connector；写操作需一次性授权。改编自 OpenAI 的 MIT Zotero 插件（openai/plugins）；每日自动导入的定时任务仅支持 Windows。

Requires Windows, Origin/OriginPro 2021+ and Python 3.10+, plus `pip install originpro numpy` into the interpreter dsh launches: without the package every tool answers `missing_originpro`, and without an interpreter on PATH no tools register at all.

description.en: Shell-style prompt history in the DSH composer: ↑ in an empty composer recalls the previous prompt and keeps walking back, ↓ walks forward to the empty draft; history is kept per workspace, persisted across restarts and records only human input, while typing or editing a draft returns ↑/↓ to normal caret movement. Adds a Settings page to export, import and clear the history.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框里提供 shell 风格的提示词历史：空输入框按 ↑ 取回上一条并继续向前翻，按 ↓ 向后回到空草稿；历史按工作区隔离、落盘并在重启后保留，且只记录人工输入，一旦手动输入或编辑草稿，↑/↓ 就恢复为正常的光标移动。另提供设置页可导出、导入和清空历史。

description.en: Data asset attestation plugin that generates certification-level data quality reports with evidence chains.
description.zh: 数据资产认证报告插件 — 生成带证据链的认证级数据质量报告

description.en: Data asset valuation plugin with cost-based (replacement cost) and income-based valuation.

description.en: Data packaging plugin for product manual generation and compliance attachments.
description.zh: 数据封装插件 — 产品说明书生成+合规附件

description.en: Full-text search for DeepSeek Harness sessions with precise message navigation.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个会话全文搜索浮窗，搜到关键词就能跳转并高亮那条消息。

description.en: English edition of Weiwen's Law (KISS's Law): the first and only domain-agnostic white-box causal adjudication middleware for AI agents. Unlike domain-specific causal-inference tooling (statistics/economics/ML) or evidence-gated agent firewalls, it adjudicates *every* tool call along a deterministic structural causal chain (R->S->D->H->M) before execution - across any domain, with no training or per-domain tuning. It blocks destructive and credential-file operations, escalates repeated boundary violations, cuts faulting links until verified-fixed, and gives risk verdicts on un-auditable execution; runs fully local with zero API cost.
description.zh: 唯稳律（KISS's Law）英文版：业界首个且唯一的领域无关白箱因果裁决中间件。与领域特定的因果推断工具（统计/经济/机器学习）或「需提供因果证据」的代理防火墙不同，它在执行前对*每个*工具调用沿确定性结构因果链（R->S->D->H->M）裁决——适用任意领域，无需训练或按领域调参。拦截破坏性与凭据文件操作、对反复越界升级止损、故障环节切断至修复验证、不可审计执行给出风险判定；纯本地运行、零 API 成本。

description.en: Opt-in detached watchdog for the DSH Web process with snapshot-checked repair and explicit patch restoration.
description.zh: Opt-in detached watchdog for the DSH Web process with snapshot-checked repair and explicit patch restoration.

description.en: Aggregates every WorkBuddy account already signed in on this machine into one model pool, with manual and scheduled check-in, credits and expiry monitoring, per-model credit multipliers, and account switching with remaining credits right below the composer.
description.zh: 把本机所有登录过的 WorkBuddy 账号聚合成一个模型池，带手动与自动签到、积分与到期监控、模型倍率，并可在输入框下方切换账号、查看剩余总积分。

description.en: Monitors IEEE Xplore journal Early Access through Crossref, has an LLM screen every new paper against your keywords, and emails a Markdown weekly digest.
description.zh: 按关键词盯 IEEE 期刊 Early Access：Crossref 抓新收录，逐篇交给大模型研判，生成 Markdown 周报并发到邮箱。

QQ Zone poster for DeepSeek Harness: scan a QQ login once, then let the model publish posts with mood-matched sticker images, with a daily cap and a silent headless Chrome session.

Three modes: Q&A (summary+recommendations), Encyclopedia (adjustable depth), Browse (feed of articles/videos/images weighted by relevance, recency, popularity). Supports result language and search history.
description.zh: 无广告 AI 搜索面板，答疑、百科、浏览三种模式，联网检索后自动过滤广告并生成摘要推荐。

description.en: DogCatTrace attribution parody as a right-sidebar tab: draw three integer challenges, paste each model reply into one box at a time, read the 24-breed dog and cat ranking.
description.zh: 猫狗品种归因的侧栏插件：出三道整数挑战，逐段贴回模型回复，看 24 个品种的降序榜。

description.en: QQ bot control center for DeepSeek Harness: one-click NapCat/Koishi setup, message monitor, permissions, and AI chat with personas/memory.

description.zh: 把 QQ 接入 DSH 的一键部署插件，自动装好桥接引擎、配置和 systemd 服务，还带低成本 lite 模式。

description.en: 大鲸鱼在线写插件 · 让鲸鱼去监督鲸鱼：在 DSH 侧栏每条会话行上铺一条半透明进度带，每 30 秒用一个轻量模型读上下文估进度；可选监督模型、可调思考强度、可改颜色与样式，左侧栏还能看到判断模型的每一次原始输出。

description.en: Superpowers skills for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a full engineering methodology served through dsh's own filesystem skill provider, with an always-on bootstrap.
description.zh: 给 dsh agent 装上整套工程方法论，任务一匹配就自动加载对应技能，从头脑风暴到 TDD 全程自主执行。

description.zh: 任务跑完、输出停下时冒一串「咕噜」气泡音，提醒你活儿干完了。

description.en: Ollama Cloud provider for DeepSeek Harness with native and OpenAI-compatible transports.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Ollama Cloud 模型接入，支持原生及 OpenAI 兼容传输。

description.en: OpenCode Console and OpenCode Go provider for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenCode Console 与 OpenCode Go 两个 provider。

description.en: Writes one short line into the system prompt only when a stress, energy or reward value crosses a threshold; the values rise on real session events and decay over time.

The replier can read the session, the working directory and, if you turn it on, the web, but changes nothing. Commented passages stay highlighted with a badge that shows unread replies, and Send to chat hands a thread to the agent when you want it acted on.

description.en: Project-scoped SQLite memory with progressive retrieval, bounded context, a composer button and visual review. Install the repository-root DSH bundle, then run /learning-init with an absolute project path using local Python 3.10+.

description.en: Keep a DSH turn alive across provider hiccups: in-session auto retry until success, model fallback with dead-route guard, right-sidebar status panel

description.en: 一个能让大肥鱼自动查看余额的插件。你直接在QQ里问她：帮我查一下余额，她就能报出来数字。

description.zh: 输入论文需求，自动检索知网、精读文献并分步写出不虚构的论文初稿。

description.en: Columbina 2D live desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness — 76 official voice lines in CN/JP/EN, weather reports, sticker moments, late-night whispers.
description.zh: 把哥伦比娅请上桌面当 2D 桌宠，76 句中英日原声台词，还能报天气、发贴纸、深夜陪聊。

description.en: Connectome — an interactive, canvas-rendered map of a DeepSeek Harness workspace's files and their imports (DSH plugin)
description.zh: 把工作区文件和依赖关系画成可交互的力导向图，一眼看清谁引用了谁。

description.en: Cap DSH desktop session cookie lifetime to avoid HTTP 431 / Web authentication failed startup crash. 修复 DSH 桌面端 dsh-auth-* cookie 累积导致的启动崩溃。
description.zh: 限制 DSH 桌面端会话 cookie 的有效期，防止 cookie 越积越多导致启动崩溃。

description.en: 扫描版教材流水线：OCR提速5倍，先出骨架地图，再按章阅读。
description.zh: 把扫描版教材 PDF 变成读书心得骨架，OCR 提速 5 倍，先出地图再按章读。

description.en: DeepSeek API 余额，常驻在 dsh 输入框旁边。零配置、零 token 成本。
description.zh: 在 dsh 输入框旁常驻显示 DeepSeek API 余额，点一下就能刷新，零配置零 token 消耗。

description.en: Replies to DingTalk direct messages as your own account — reads the bound DSH workspace, writes the answer, and sends it back through the dws CLI.
description.zh: 以你本人钉钉身份自动回复私聊：在绑定的 DSH 工作区里查资料生成回答，通过 dws CLI 以本人身份发出。

description.en: 给deepseek harness添加更方便快捷的重启方式 Add a more convenient and efficient restart method to the deepseek harness
description.zh: 给 DSH 桌面版菜单加个原生「重启」项，就在「退出」上面，点一下就能快速重启。

description.en: 模拟记忆衰退的 DSH 分层上下文压缩插件：原文 → L1 → L2 → L3，越旧分辨率越低，但从不删除。
description.zh: 把对话上下文按新旧分层压缩，越旧越精简但永不删除，帮模型在长会话里省 token 又不丢记忆。

description.en: 经验库：dsh-mnemon 的记忆空间 Provider（exp-lib），同时注册 exp_recall / exp_record 工具（JitRL 优势排序）。
🐋 大肥鱼衣橱 — DSH 插件：token 花销变鱼粮，解锁 21 件原创换装 + 1080×1440 饲养报告卡（纯本地，零额外模型调用）
description.zh: 把 token 花销变成鱼粮，喂大肥鱼解锁 21 套换装和饲养报告卡，纯本地运行不额外调用模型。

description.en: 将api连接到桌宠上，并且允许桌宠查看你的电脑屏幕。             在本项目中，桌宠会读取你的桌面信息，并自行决定是否和你交流。            交流方面，桌宠可以选择直接发消息或者做动作；你对桌宠的互动也会被桌宠读取到，她可能会对你的互动做出反应。            记忆方面，项目采取本地文件夹存放记忆(桌宠自行决定哪些值得存放)，并采用短期记忆直接读取，长期记忆索引读取的方式，缓解上下文过长的问题。
description.zh: 把蓝色小鲸桌宠接到你自己的 API，让它看屏幕、自己决定聊不聊、还能记住你。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 一键分组提交插件：Angular 规范分组、当前模型生成 message、插件直接执行 git 提交
description.zh: 按 Angular 规范自动分组改动，用当前模型生成提交信息并直接执行 git 提交，省去手写 commit 的麻烦。

description.en: Harness RAG for DeepSeek Harness: three-path retrieval, document continuation reading and a knowledge-base panel.
DeepSeek Harness 的窗口内线电话 —— 让已经开着的会话窗口互相喊话，不建团队、不生新会话
description.zh: 让已经开着的会话窗口互相喊话，不建团队、不生新会话，随手就能通气。
把 JiuwenSwarm 接进 dsh 当大脑用，其他插件照常运行不冲突。
给 Harness 补上本地事实层：探测环境、检查功能产出、把 git 变成模型能直接调用的工具、写文件前自动快照，还能跑项目自带检查。

description.en: A guard for DeepSeek Harness: stops model repeat loops mid-stream, prunes and compacts context, then resumes the task.
description.zh: 循环卡住或中断时自动检测、剪枝、压缩上下文并续跑，帮会话快速恢复。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for controlling maa-cli with natural language and local commands
description.zh: 用自然语言和本地命令操控 maa-cli，让日常任务跑起来更省事。

description.en: MATLAB in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: VS Code-like .m editor, warm MATLAB session (figures open), workspace variables, .mlx preview, matlab_run agent tool.
description.zh: 在侧边栏里直接写和跑 MATLAB 代码，变量、图形、.mlx 预览都能看，还能让 AI 帮你执行。

description.en: Provider-level model pool for DSH — virtual ModelPool provider with Auto and named pools, chain failover a→b→c→d, per-source cooldown bench, reasoning-effort aware.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一个虚拟模型池，自动在多个模型间按顺序切换，某个挂了就换下一个，还能按来源冷却。

description.en: 一个 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：只注册一个 shell 工具，但让模型在每次调用时自己选后端—— Git Bash（默认）、PowerShell、WSL。
description.zh: 只装一个 shell 工具，模型每次调用时自己挑 Git Bash、PowerShell 或 WSL 后端，Windows 上切换环境不用换插件。

description.en: DSH plugin: plain-language narration, an uncertainty gate, and mid-run interruption policy for DeepSeek Harness agents.
description.zh: 给 DSH Agent 加一层保镖：动作前用白话说明、不确定先问、执行中一插话就停。

description.en: Neuron-inspired memory framework + 3D neuron star-ring panel for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一套仿神经元的分层记忆，对话自动归档、定时整理，还有 3D 星云面板看记忆。

description.en: DSH 守夜插件：给输入框加一颗按钮，选个钟点，会话一直续跑到那时自动停
description.zh: 给输入框加个按钮，选个钟点，会话就一直跑到那时自动停，不用守着。

description.en: dsh-ntr 0.1.5 的个人构建版：普通对话可直接切到 CodeBuddy / Claude Code 等 ACP agent 的模型，首次切换自动带上会话历史。
description.zh: 普通对话一键切到 CodeBuddy、Claude Code 等 ACP 模型，首次切换自动带上历史，省得重讲一遍。

description.en: An offline novel reader: imports .txt and .epub into the right sidebar, shows the chapter being read in a resizable peek window above the composer, and resumes each book at the paragraph and in-paragraph position it was closed at.
description.zh: 离线小说阅读器：把 .txt 与 .epub 导入右侧栏，在输入框上方用一个可缩放大小的速览窗显示正在读的章节，每本书都从关闭时的段落与段内位置继续。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：Python 快捷执行工具，源码经 stdin 直灌 `python -X utf8 -u -`，一步返回结果，全链路 UTF-8，支持后台作业与沙箱提权。
description.zh: 直接给 Python 源码就能跑，一步出结果，不用再折腾转义和临时脚本。

description.en: 插件工坊 Plugin Studio for DeepSeek Harness — 三级自动分类、批量删除、AI 大白话讲解、最后使用时间、技能管理、一键打包
description.zh: 一个页面管好 DSH 的插件和技能：自动分类、批量删除、AI 大白话讲解、一键打包。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）桌面端的 Agent 预设管理器：顶栏切换预设、按预设注入工具引导、子代理预设策略、预设包导入导出，并附带「标准模式·加强版」预设。Agent preset manager for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端的 Agent 预设管理器，会话中途切预设、按预设注入工具引导，还能导入导出预设包。

description.en: Saves tokens in DeepSeek Harness sessions by reading any file by line range or symbol mention instead of whole, and by bounding oversized tool results while keeping a recovery path. Pruning happens at the source, not after content reaches the context. Measured 43.9% fewer prompt tokens in a modelled 30-step session.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话节省 token：按行号或符号定位读取文件而不是整份读，并对过大的工具结果设上限且保留取回路径。修剪发生在源头，而不是内容进入上下文之后。在建模的 30 步会话上实测 prompt tokens 减少 43.9%。

description.en: DSH 插件：无限大白饭模式。三档切换（关/本轮/常开），控制要不要往系统提示里注入「别省 token」的指令。
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个「无限大白饭」开关，三档切换，让模型放开手脚干活不省 token。

description.en: Session board orb: live thinking and tool progress per session, task duration, context usage and 12h/30d usage stats; click through to any session.
description.zh: 会话看板：悬浮球一览所有工作区会话，实时显示思考与工具进展、任务耗时、上下文用量，支持近 12h/30 天用量统计，点击直达会话。

description.en: Search every DSH chat session and jump to the matched message. 跨会话搜索 DSH 聊天记录并跳到命中的那条消息。
description.zh: 跨会话搜索 DSH 聊天记录，打开会话后自动定位并跳到命中的那条消息。

description.en: Multi-engine image generation for DeepSeek Harness: agent tool + composer-dock panel (Volcengine Ark / SiliconFlow / OpenAI-compatible).
description.zh: 在对话里直接说一句就能生成图片，支持火山方舟、硅基流动等多个引擎，还能在面板里调参数。

description.en: Manage skill experts in the sidebar and summon them from the composer or @ menu
description.zh: 在侧边栏管理技能专家，聊天时从输入框或 @ 菜单一键召唤，让专业任务交给对口的专家处理。

description.en: Smart naming for DeepSeek Harness sessions and workspaces — short names from the item's own content, one click to rename.
description.zh: 读取会话或工作区内容，自动生成几个短名候选，点一下就能改名，省得自己起名。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to a local SolidWorks install through an MCP server, with a read-only default mode and per-call confirmation for high-risk operations. Windows 10/11 x64 only; needs Python 3.10+ with mcp, pydantic and jsonschema (plus pywin32 and comtypes on Windows) and a local SolidWorks 2023-2026 installed and started at least once.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 服务器把 DeepSeek Harness 接入本机 SolidWorks，默认只读模式，高风险操作逐次确认。仅 Windows 10/11 x64；需 Python 3.10+ 并装好 mcp、pydantic、jsonschema（Windows 上还需 pywin32、comtypes），且本机已安装并至少启动过一次 SolidWorks 2023–2026。

description.en: Show two DSH sessions side by side in one window. Draggable split, per-pane session switch, Agent Teams support.
description.zh: 在一个窗口里左右并排开两个会话，各自独立聊天干活，还能拖动分栏调宽度。

description.en: 官方 subagent 的默认策略包：装上一次配好「什么时候自己干、什么时候派出去、派给谁」。
description.zh: 装一次就配好 subagent 委派策略：什么时候自己干、什么时候派出去、派给谁，全自动写进提示词。

description.en: DSH Task Shelf 1 — 跨工作区、跨会话整理与压缩交接
description.zh: 把不同工作区、不同会话的相关内容打包成一个交接资料夹，还能按需压缩，下次回来直接接着干。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的「特蕾西娅」主题插件：象牙白 / 墨 / 淡玫瑰配色，整页背景图、毛玻璃侧栏、侧栏立绘、四角金线、落款签名与开屏动画，全部可在设置里调。
description.zh: 给 DSH 换上特蕾西娅配色氛围，背景立绘开屏动画都能在设置里调，缺素材也能直接用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness native plugin for ui-ux-pro-max: bundled skill data, native search / design-system tools, auto re-vendor from upstream
description.zh: 把 ui-ux-pro-max 的设计数据库搬进 DSH，搜风格、配色、字体和 UX 准则一键搞定。

description.en: Syntax highlighting, copy button and monochrome mode for code blocks in DeepSeek Harness Desktop (DSH) chat user messages. No dependencies, no build step.
description.zh: 给 DSH 聊天里用户消息的代码块加上语法高亮、一键复制和黑白模式，装好就能用。

description.en: Local, HTTP and trusted-header authentication with per-user workspace isolation for DeepSeek Harness Web UI

description.zh: 给 DSH 加一道工作区外访问守卫，读取外部文件需经你同意，三档模式灵活控制。
给欧陆风云5的MOD作者用：填名称描述、挑修正，AI补触发与效果，实时生成脚本和本地化并写入MOD文档。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: run a remote DSH inside the desktop app window (SSH bootstrap, auto-install, loopback gateway, embedded panel)
description.zh: 在桌面应用侧边栏直接连上远程 Linux 的 DSH，选好主机就能用远端会话和文件，像本地一样顺手。
写文件和读敏感配置都得先过你这一关，破坏性操作还要确认两次，防止 AI 乱动。

description.en: KuroWhale is an unofficial dark-themed whale-girl desktop companion for Windows x64, inspired by the DeepSeek Harness icon, with nine animations that react to DSH Agent activity. Requires WebView2; the first launch downloads the official Neutralino 6.9.0 runtime and artwork over the network and verifies them by SHA-256.
description.zh: KuroWhale 黑色系鲸鱼娘桌宠，参考 DeepSeek Harness 官方图标设计的非官方 Windows x64 桌宠，九种动画会随 DSH Agent 的工作状态作出反应；需要 WebView2，首次启动会联网下载官方 Neutralino 6.9.0 运行时与素材并做 SHA-256 校验。

description.en: Browses the awesome-claude-video-skills catalog (373 entries) inside DSH settings and installs a chosen skill into ~/.claude/skills and/or ~/.dsh/skills: it downloads the GitHub archive of that repository and copies the skill directory, and executes no code from the repository. Installs run as background jobs with live progress (bytes downloaded, files copied) and can be cancelled; skills installed by the plugin can be uninstalled, while directories without its marker are left untouched. Rows show an approximate repository size reported by GitHub. The same actions are exposed to the agent as the video_skill_search, video_skill_install and video_skill_uninstall tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置里浏览 awesome-claude-video-skills 目录（373 条），把选中的技能装进 ~/.claude/skills 和/或 ~/.dsh/skills：下载该仓库的 GitHub 归档并复制技能目录，不执行仓库里的任何代码。安装以后台任务运行、显示实时进度（已下载字节与已复制文件数）并可取消；本插件装上的技能可以卸载，没有本插件标记的目录保持不动。列表显示 GitHub 报告的仓库体积近似值。同样的能力也以 video_skill_search、video_skill_install、video_skill_uninstall 三个工具暴露给智能体。

description.en: Image generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness — Doubao Seedream 5.0 Pro / qwen-image-3.0-pro, watermark-free, verbatim in-image text, inline chat display.
description.zh: 给 DSH 智能体加上文生图能力，支持豆包 Seedream 5.0 Pro 和 qwen-image-3.0-pro，出图无水印、文字精准，还能直接在对话里显示。

description.en: Adds an appearance settings page to DeepSeek Harness: five eye-comfort light themes, each with its own accent and link colours, plus controls for the accent and background colours, UI and code fonts and sizes, font styles, content width, contrast and reduced motion.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加外观设置页：五套护眼浅色主题，每套主题自带匹配的强调色与链接色；另可调整强调色与背景色、界面与代码的字体和字号、字体样式、内容宽度、对比度与减少动态效果。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness native SSH terminal and SFTP workspace with direct agent tools and security sandboxing.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生 SSH 终端与 SFTP 远程工作区，支持 Agent 直连运维与三级安全沙盒。

description.en: DSH plugin: a better-sidebar tab embedding the VS Code web workbench at the session workspace; editor selections and explorer files land as atomic reference chips
description.zh: 在侧边栏嵌入 VS Code 网页版，选中代码或文件可一键转为引用片段，提升开发效率。

description.en: Translate text-based PDFs via DeepSeek or OpenAI-compatible APIs while preserving layout, fonts, images and links, with editable output.
description.zh: 用 DeepSeek 或兼容 API 翻译文本型 PDF，保留版式、字体、图片与链接，输出可编辑 PDF。

description.en: Task-to-skill pairing meta-skill with a laziness ladder for minimal loading, a user-editable routing table, and a quarantine, SkillSpector scan, human-approval install flow.
description.zh: 任务到技能配对元技能：懒人阶梯最小化加载、可编辑路由表、隔离-SkillSpector 扫描-人工确认的安装流程。

description.en: Beads issue browser in the right sidebar: filter and search the tracker with live ready and waiting counts, read issue Markdown with clickable project-file and issue links, and copy or insert the issue id. Requires the bd CLI on PATH and a project with a Beads workspace.
description.zh: 右侧栏的 Beads 议题浏览器：按可开工、受阻与各状态筛选并搜索 tracker，阅读渲染后的议题正文，其中的项目文件与议题 id 可直接点击，并可一键复制或插入 id。需要 PATH 上的 bd CLI，以及已初始化 Beads 工作区的项目。

description.en: LAN phone drop: a QR code on the computer screen opens a page on the phone, and photos or scanned documents land in a computer folder over the local network, with no tunnel and no cloud in between. Document mode binarizes locally in the browser (adaptive threshold plus speckle removal and edge crop) so an ordinary phone photo comes out as a black-and-white scan. Adds a "phone drop" entry at the foot of the DSH sidebar that opens the QR page, plus a phone_drop tool for the assistant; the same CLI also runs standalone without DSH.
description.zh: 局域网手机直传：电脑屏幕上出一个二维码，手机扫开就能拍照或扫描，文件直接落进电脑文件夹，全程局域网直连，不经过隧道也不经过云端。文档模式在手机浏览器里本地做自适应二值化、去噪、裁边，把普通照片变成黑白扫描件。插件会在 DSH 侧边栏底部加一个「手机直传」入口，点开就是二维码页；另有 phone_drop 工具供助手调用，同一个 CLI 也能脱离 DSH 独立运行。

description.en: Zero-friction quick ask for DSH: select text in chat, Markdown/code, rendered HTML reports, or the better-sidebar editor. The default answer starts automatically (English prose is translated, a term is explained, a question is answered); typing cancels it. Answers stream from a one-shot completion on the main window's model, inherit a read-only conversation snapshot, read the selected file as context (up to 20,000 characters by default), and never write to the main session. One-line install; host routes, client slots, document renderers and the iframe selection bridge are separable extension points.
description.zh: DSH 的零摩擦快问：对话、Markdown/代码、渲染后的 HTML 报告、better-sidebar 编辑器里都能划词。默认回答会自动开始（英文正文先翻译、术语解释概念、问句直接回答），输入即取消。答案由一次性 completion 流式产出，沿用主窗口模型，继承只读对话快照，把所选文件作为上下文读取（默认上限 2 万字符），且不写入主会话。一行命令安装；宿主路由、客户端插槽、文档 renderer、iframe 选区桥都是可分离的扩展点。

description.en: Runs the locally installed ZCode CLI as a `zcode` model route in DSH: all traffic is signed by the official binary, the plugin never sends its own request, forges client requests or sends credentials off the machine (the plan token is decrypted in memory only to hand back to the official CLI), no API key is needed, and both a paid one-shot and a free app-server channel are supported. Since v0.3.0 it ships an HTTP MCP bridge so tool calls run through the DSH approval surface. Backed by a contract document and a node --test gate.
description.zh: 把本机已安装的 ZCode CLI 接成 DSH 的 `zcode` 模型路由：流量全部由官方二进制签名，插件自身不发请求、不伪造客户端请求、不把凭据传出本机（plan token 只在内存中解密并交还官方 CLI），不需要 API Key，付费一次性与免费 app-server 两条通道并存；v0.3.0 起内建 HTTP MCP 工具桥，工具调用走 DSH 的审批面；有契约文档与 node --test 测试门禁背书。

description.en: Native discovery and per-agent loading of built-in, plugin and MCP tools, with BM25 and optional Ollama or OpenAI-compatible embeddings.
description.zh: 内置工具、插件工具与 MCP 工具的原生发现与按 agent 加载，支持 BM25 检索，可选 Ollama 或 OpenAI 兼容的向量检索。

description.en: Always-on AI teammate: hand it a recurring task in one sentence; dry-run rehearsal by default, snapshot before every real run, one-click rollback, CNY budget circuit-breaker, per-run cost transparency.
description.zh: 常驻 AI 队友：一句自然语言交给它长期值守；默认演习、执行前后双快照、一键整单回滚、人民币预算熔断、逐轮费用透明。

description.en: Strips DSML markers that leak into the assistant text stream and resumes a turn only when it genuinely produced nothing — an invoke-block leak with no tool call emitted, or a closing-tag leak whose prose is near-empty; upstream jitter codes retry, while quota, rate-limit, auth and context-window errors never do. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or newer, below 0.3.0, and Node 20 or newer.
description.zh: 抹掉漏进助手正文的 DSML 标记；只在确实毫无产出的轮次补一条继续——整段调用写进正文且没有发出任何工具调用，或只剩闭合标签且正文近乎为空。上游抖动类错误会续跑，额度、限流、鉴权与上下文超限一律不续。适用 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 起、0.3.0 以下，Node 20 起。

description.en: Lets the model turn an answer into a web page that lives right inside the chat. The show_page tool either fills one of 8 built-in templates (report, compare, checklist, dashboard, timeline, flashcards, quiz, flow), where the model writes only the content and the plugin does layout, interaction and saving, or saves a full page the model wrote itself (calculators, games, custom layouts). Hand-written pages get the same design as base styles inside a CSS @layer, so the page's own CSS still wins. The page appears under the reply at its content height, interactive and following DSH's light/dark theme. The page's localStorage is stored in DSH per page, so what users tick or type survives reopening and new versions, and the same page open in the chat and the right sidebar stays in sync. Each edit is saved as a new version you can flip back to. After saving, the page is checked in a hidden local Chrome or Edge (script errors, horizontal overflow, dark mode not applied) and problems go back to the model. The right sidebar shows the page full-size with versions, a gallery of all pages and export to PNG, PDF or HTML. Pages run in a sandboxed, separate-origin frame with a strict CSP: no access to DSH data and no fetch, XHR or WebSocket. Works on phones with dsh-mobile.
description.zh: 让模型把回答做成一页网页，直接放在对话里。show_page 工具可以套 8 种内置模板（报告、对比、清单、数据看板、时间线、学习卡片、测验、流程图），模型只写内容，排版、交互和保存由插件做；也可以存模型自己写的整页（计算器、小游戏、特别的版式）。自己写的页面也套上同一套设计，放在 CSS @layer 里，页面自己的样式照样盖得过它。页面按内容高度嵌在回复下面，能点能用，深浅色跟着 DSH 走。页面里的 localStorage 按页面存在 DSH 里，勾过、填过的东西重开、改出新版本都还在；同一页同时开在对话里和右侧栏，两边实时同步。改一次存一版，旧版能翻。存好后在本机一个看不见的 Chrome / Edge 里体检（脚本报错、横向溢出、深色没跟上），问题交回模型改。右侧栏看整页、翻版本、看所有做过的页面，导出 PNG / PDF / HTML。页面跑在不同源的沙箱框里，CSP 很严：读不到 DSH 的数据，也不能联网取数据。配合 dsh-mobile 手机上也能用。

description.en: Windows only (x64): browse, preview and export Unreal Engine 4/5 cooked assets from local PAK archives via CUE4Parse; Oodle-compressed archives need Epic's oo2core DLL, which is not bundled but can be downloaded from the settings page.
description.zh: 仅 Windows x64：浏览、预览并导出本地 PAK 归档中的 UE4/5 烘焙资产（CUE4Parse）；Oodle 压缩的归档需要 Epic 的 oo2core DLL，包内不含，可在设置页一键下载。

description.en: Connects a GitHub account to DSH from the composer button (OAuth device flow or a personal access token) and exposes one github_api tool for REST calls — create repositories, write files, read pull requests and workflow runs — with a read-only switch and an in-panel call log. A rewritten fork of Moon-shiyue/dsh-github-connect (MIT): device-flow Client IDs are no longer rejected, paths may carry query strings and non-ASCII characters, undici is no longer a hard dependency, and the panel has four tabs. Registers the same github_api tool name and the same credential namespace, so it cannot be installed alongside that plugin.
description.zh: 在对话框左下角连接你的 GitHub 账号（设备流或 Personal Access Token），提供一个 github_api 工具直接调 REST 接口——建仓库、写文件、读 PR 与 Actions，带只读开关和调用记录。改自 Moon-shiyue/dsh-github-connect（MIT）：不再拒收设备流 Client ID，路径可带查询串与非 ASCII 字符，不再硬依赖 undici，面板改成四页签。工具名 github_api 与凭据命名空间都与原插件相同，两者不能同时安装。

description.en: Closes right-sidebar tabs with a middle click or a left double click, reusing the built-in close button so the native rules (such as the last docked guide card being unclosable) still apply.
description.zh: 右侧栏标签页支持鼠标中键关闭与左键双击关闭，关闭动作复用原生 × 按钮，原生规则（例如唯一停靠的 guide 卡片关不掉）保持不变。

description.en: Strict workflow document viewer and lifecycle driver for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中查看和驱动严格规范与工作流文档的插件。

description.en: Annotate replies and documents for the next message, edit past user messages and rerun from that point, and use keyboard shortcuts to navigate user messages or recall previous inputs in the composer.
description.zh: 为回复和文档添加随下一条消息发送的注释，编辑历史用户消息并从该处重新执行，使用快捷键浏览用户消息或在输入框调出历史输入。

description.en: Adds the models available in a signed-in WorkBuddy desktop app to DeepSeek Harness as a model provider, with the CN and international apps as separate groups. It is a rebuilt derivative of the npm package dsh-workbuddy-connect@0.7.9 (originally corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect); it registers the same workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider ids, so it cannot be installed alongside other WorkBuddy bridges.
description.zh: 把已登录的 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 中的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，国内版与国际版各自成组。它基于 npm 包 dsh-workbuddy-connect@0.7.9（原 corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect）的构建产物改出，注册相同的 workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider id，不能与其它 WorkBuddy 桥同装。

description.en: Bing daily wallpaper as the app background: auto-refresh every day, pin any of the last 30 days.
description.zh: 必应每日壁纸作为界面背景：每天自动更换，可在最近 30 天中任选一天固定。

description.en: Embed a local web server in the DSH GUI through a remote-browser-safe same-origin proxy: any localhost port works, plus a Console/Network/Errors toolbox that captures what the iframe actually does.
description.zh: 把本地网页服务安全地嵌进 DSH 界面：同源代理绕开远程浏览器的 localhost/混合内容限制，任意 localhost 端口可用，并附控制台/网络/错误工具箱，实时捕获 iframe 内真实行为。

description.en: Registers Mol* file viewers with dsh-better-sidebar for PDB, mmCIF, MRC maps, small molecules and Chimera .cmm markers, including .gz, with a BioViewer workspace tab and bio_open / bio_add tools.
description.zh: 向 dsh-better-sidebar 注册 Mol* 文件预览器，支持 PDB、mmCIF、MRC 密度图、小分子和 Chimera .cmm 标记（含 .gz），并提供 BioViewer 工作区标签以及 bio_open / bio_add 工具。

description.en: RunningHub media tools: synchronous image generation, plus a background workflow pool for image editing, video generation, voice cloning, digital humans, and music.
description.zh: RunningHub 媒体工具：同步图片生成，以及覆盖图片编辑、视频生成、语音克隆、数字人与音乐的后台工作流任务池。

description.en: Per-session status chips in the GNOME top bar for DeepSeek Harness — gray for running, green for done, yellow for waiting — configurable from the sidebar, with a self-installed GNOME extension.
description.zh: 在 GNOME 顶栏显示 DSH 各会话状态色块（灰=运行中，绿=已完成未确认，黄=等待回复/审批），可在侧边栏配置，自动安装 GNOME 扩展。

description.en: Plays a character entrance card beside the composer when you switch model: identity name, six scored axes (intelligence, coding, speed, stability, cost, context), quota hint and a dialogue line. 23 curated cards across 15 providers; models without a curated card fall back to a data card derived from public benchmarks, or a generic card when no benchmark data exists. A web client plugin with no dependencies and no hooks.
description.zh: 切换模型时在会话输入框旁播一张角色登场卡：身份名、六轴分数（智力／编码／速度／稳定／性价比／上下文）、额度提示与台词；23 张精选卡覆盖 15 个 provider，库里没有精选卡的模型按公开基准派生数据卡；基准集里也没有分数的则回退为通用卡。web 客户端插件，无依赖、无 hooks。

description.en: Tints the strip above the composer green or red to match DeepSeek's off-peak and peak billing windows, shows the remaining time of the current window as a progress bar, and ships six themes plus a custom-CSS hook.
description.zh: 按 DeepSeek 峰谷计费时段给输入卡上方那条染色（谷绿峰红），以进度条显示当前时段剩余时长，带六套主题与自定义 CSS。

description.en: Reads IDEA run configurations and launches Java, Spring Boot and Vue projects inside DeepSeek Harness, with colored logs and a fast java -cp startup path.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里读取 IDEA 运行配置，启动 Java / Spring Boot / Vue 项目并查看彩色日志，支持快速启动（java -cp 直启）。

description.en: Annotates pages inside the built-in browser: click an element, write a comment, and send the batch to the conversation as one message, with a cropped screenshot per note where the element can be located.
description.zh: 在内置浏览器里给网页元素写批注，整批发进对话；每条批注附一张能定位到元素的裁剪截图。

description.en: Marks a Session as focus or parked in one click from its sidebar row, its hover card, or the conversation header, and keeps a count visible at the foot of the sidebar and next to workspace folder names when those groups are collapsed. A panel lists every marked Session alongside the states the sidebar already tracks (waiting for a reply, running, finished-unread), and the sidebar foot opens whichever one needs a reply first.
description.zh: 从会话行、悬浮卡或会话头一点即可标记「进行中／挂起」；侧边栏底部和折叠的工作区名旁始终显示还有几条。面板把标记过的会话与侧边栏本就跟踪的状态（等待回复、在跑、已完成未查看）列在一起，底部读数则直接跳到最该处理的那一条。

description.en: Opens a dedicated question chat in the right sidebar for text selected in a DSH conversation, so follow-up questions do not push the main conversation away and never appear in the session list.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中选中一段文字，右侧栏即开出独立的提问对话，与主对话分屏并排，追问不会顶走正在学的内容，也不会出现在左侧会话列表里。

description.en: GLM Coding Plan usage quota ring in the composer dock - 5-hour and weekly credit windows with level, auto-refresh and one-click retry. Requires a GLM Coding Plan subscription and key, plus your BigModel organization and project IDs (the team quota API returns empty without them).
description.zh: 输入框下方实时显示 GLM Coding Plan 额度环 - 5 小时与每周额度窗口、等级、自动刷新与一键重试。需 GLM Coding Plan 订阅与 key，并配置 BigModel 的 organization 与 project ID（团队额度接口缺了它们会返回空）。

description.en: Two DSH delegation presets — a fixed 8-seat crew, or up to 3 day-rate temps by convention — with call-time guards that refuse the other shape's delegation tools. The 8-seat preset additionally needs @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile in the profile's dsh.profile.bundles; without it that preset has no team tools and degrades to solo work.
description.zh: 给 DSH 装两条干活形态——8 个固定工位的终身奴，或按约定一次最多点 3 个的日结奴；跨形态调用会在调用时被 guard 拒绝。8 工位形态还需在 profile 的 dsh.profile.bundles 里挂 @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile，否则该形态没有 Team 工具、会降级为单人作业。

description.en: Hides opted-in third-party skills and MCP servers from the model-facing catalogs and serves them through one capability tool: search by intent, read the schema or the skill instructions, then call. A local journal records metadata only, never query text or arguments.
description.zh: 把选定代管的第三方技能与 MCP 服务器从原生工具目录收起，改由单个 capability 工具统一提供：按意图搜索、读 schema 或技能说明，再调用。本地日志只记录元数据，不记录查询文本与参数。

description.en: Reads EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, TXT and PDF books in a side panel with pagination, table-of-contents jumping, highlights, notes, bookmarks, full-text search, anchored AI questions and per-chapter distillation. PDF support is text-based only; scanned or encrypted PDFs are rejected.
description.zh: 在侧边面板里读 EPUB、MOBI、AZW3、TXT、PDF 五种格式的书：分页、目录跳转、划线笔记与书签、全文搜索、带原文锚点的 AI 问答，以及按章蒸馏。PDF 仅支持文字版，扫描件与加密 PDF 会被拒绝。

description.en: Paints a colored counter badge (green = unread completed sessions, orange = pending question or approval) on the DeepSeek Harness taskbar icon on Windows, and plays a chime when a session finishes. Fork of dthcle/dsh-badge-notify (MIT) with a completion chime and green/orange state colors; both draw the same taskbar badge, so the two cannot be enabled together.
description.zh: 在 Windows 任务栏的 DeepSeek Harness 图标上叠画彩色计数角标（绿=未读的已完成会话，橙=待回答提问或待批准权限），会话结束时播放提示音。基于 dthcle/dsh-badge-notify（MIT）二次开发，新增提示音与绿/橙状态色；两者都在同一个任务栏图标上叠画角标，不能同时启用。

description.en: Adds a /new slash command that opens a blank session in the current workspace (reusing an existing blank one when there is one) and carries the old session's permission preset and agent preset into it, so starting fresh never changes what the agent may do.
description.zh: /new 指令：在当前工作区打开空白会话（已有空会话可直接复用），并把原会话的权限预设与 Agent 预设带入新会话，开新会话不会悄悄改变代理的可用权限。

description.en: Twenty-one fruit themes with original palettes and pixel fruit sprites for the DeepSeek Harness web client, including a settings gallery and an in-session style switcher.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端提供 21 套水果主题（原创配色与像素水果），含设置页画廊与会话内换肤入口。

description.en: Get back what you typed and walked away from: a new Web conversation you leave before sending never appears in the sidebar, so its draft is out of reach. This plugin lists those drafts above the composer of the next new conversation, newest first, with their workspace and time; Open takes you back with the text and chips in place, and Discard drops one, with Undo.
description.zh: 找回打了字却没发送就离开的内容：未发送就离开的新 Web 对话不会出现在侧栏，里面的草稿也就找不到了。本插件在下一个新对话的输入框上方按时间倒序列出这些草稿，并显示所属工作区与时间；「打开」带你回到原对话，文字和引用条原样还在；「丢弃」可撤销地删除草稿。

description.en: Governed literature library: import papers, extract text, keep one index row per entry, and verify quotes verbatim.
description.zh: 可治理的文献库：导入论文、抽取全文，每条文献只保留一行索引，并逐字核验摘录能在原文中查到。

description.en: Windows desktop floating assistant for DeepSeek Harness: an always-on-top chat panel with streaming answers, model switching, and region-screenshot questions.
description.zh: Windows 桌面悬浮助手：常驻置顶的对话面板，框选屏幕区域直接提问，支持流式回答、模型切换与历史记录。

description.en: Sidebar panel management for DeepSeek Harness: a grouped Panels launcher collects global panel rows and third-party plugin entry rows into one menu (clicks the original buttons), with persistent pin/unpin, a capped scrollable panel list, a toggleable compact footer, and a full Settings page — height sliders, a keep-in-place whitelist and bidirectional pin management.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏面板收纳：把全局面板行与第三方插件入口收进一个分组「面板」菜单（点击原按钮），钉住状态持久化、面板列表限高滚动、底部插件区可紧凑限高，设置页提供高度滑块、白名单常驻与双向钉住管理。

description.en: Git workflow studio for DeepSeek Harness: pick a branch model, enforce Conventional Commits, review PRs by defect density, rewrite history safely, rescue lost commits with reflog, and version releases by actual behavior change.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 工作流工作室：定分支模型、统一提交规范、按缺陷密度评 PR、安全改写历史、用 reflog 救援丢失的提交，并按真实行为变化定版本号。

description.en: API contract studio for DeepSeek Harness: decide the seven things that must be locked before coding, author and review OpenAPI, classify breaking changes by how they actually break clients, and settle error shapes, versioning and deprecation — six playbooks plus a router.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 API 契约工作室：开工前先定七件事、写/审 OpenAPI、按「客户端具体坏在哪」分类破坏性变更，再定错误结构、版本与弃用——六本手册加一个路由。

description.en: AutoBioMemory — 给 DeepSeek Harness agent 的自传体记忆插件：经历 → 第一人称事件日记 → 短时/长时记忆 → 按需回忆
description.zh: 给 DSH agent 加上自传体记忆，把经历写成第一人称日记，分短时和长时存储，需要时按需回忆。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness change review board with diff-scoped unit, edge, and exploratory self-tests.
description.zh: 改动审查台配合按 diff 推理的自测，帮智能体把每次代码改动都验清楚。

description.en: Generate interactive, single-page flowchart/sequence-diagram HTML from any codebase. AI-agent-driven; click-to-jump-to-source in your editor.
description.zh: 把代码流程一键生成可点击跳转源码的离线交互式 HTML 图表，看代码更直观

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 高效执行 Skill：将确定性操作合并为单次脚本化执行、反馈压缩为摘要并按需深读、本地核验结果、及时停止无效重试 | Efficient tool execution skill for DeepSeek Harness: batches deterministic operations into one scripted pass, compresses feedback to summaries with on-demand deep reads, verifies results locally, and stops unproductive retry loops
description.zh: 把重复操作合并成一次脚本执行，本地核验结果，帮模型省 token、少走弯路。

description.en: 给DeepSeek Harness的界面提供可更换的自定义背景和界面半透明效果
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 界面换上可自定义的全屏背景，并让聊天区、侧栏等保持半透明，好看又好读。

description.en: A lightweight DeepSeek API Peak/Off-Peak indicator for DeepSeek Harness Desktop.
description.zh: 在桌面端实时显示 DeepSeek API 处于高峰还是低谷计费，帮你挑便宜时段调用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin (desktop notifications) — Windows toasts with a sound cue when a turn finishes, needs the user, or fails.
description.zh: 任务完成、需要你处理或出错时，在 Windows 桌面弹通知并响一声提醒你。

description.en: Agnes AI image & video generation tools for DeepSeek Harness, plus optional image recognition. Text-only tool results, artifacts saved to a local folder.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里用 Agnes AI 生成图片和视频，还能按需开启图像识别，结果自动存到本地。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 手机提醒插件：AI 跑完 / 出错 / 等你审批时推到手机。7 个免费通道可选，纯提醒，不强依赖其它插件。
description.zh: AI 跑完、出错或等你审批时，自动推送到手机，7 个免费通道随便挑。

description.en: Apple-style liquid glass theme for DeepSeek Harness: composer, sidebar controls, model picker and send button, with a live 0-100% intensity control. The page background stays untouched.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上苹果风液态玻璃主题，输入框、侧边栏、模型选择和发送按钮都能调透明度。

description.en: One generative-UI surface for DeepSeek Harness: inline widgets, native charts, the 164-recipe visualization cookbook, cards, published pages, slides, design canvases, docs and downloadable files.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一个统一生成式 UI 面板，内联组件、图表、卡片、页面、幻灯片和文件都能直接画出来。

description.en: A composer button that asks first, then writes.
description.zh: 在输入框加个按钮，先问清需求再动笔，不用自己想怎么描述，选选项就行。

description.en: Side chat for DeepSeek Harness — branch the current conversation into the right dock. Mirrors the side chat in ZCode.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏开个副聊天，接着当前对话聊，不打断手头工作。

description.en: Plays a chime, raises the window and floats a card above the page when DeepSeek Harness needs your approval or a confirmation. Sound and popup toggles are independent.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 需要你确认或回答时，响铃、弹窗并置顶窗口提醒你，声音和弹窗可分别开关。

description.en: The ChatGPT-style unread badge for DeepSeek Harness — a red count on the tab icon and taskbar button, one chime per finished turn.
description.zh: 把 ChatGPT 那种红色未读角标搬到 DeepSeek Harness，回合结束在标签页和任务栏显示未读数并响一声提示。

description.en: 搜索引擎模拟器 — DSH 侧栏搜索面板插件：调用本地搜索接口，列出前 10 条结果
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏加个搜索面板，输入关键词就能调本地接口列出前 10 条真实结果。

description.en: Starts a BaseMind MCP server for each session's workspace and registers the code-intelligence tools it advertises, with no MCP row to configure. Requires BaseMind installed and on PATH (basemind serve); without it no tools are registered.
description.zh: 按会话工作区启动 BaseMind MCP server，并注册其对外提供的代码智能工具，无需配置 MCP 行。需先安装 BaseMind 并在 PATH 上（basemind serve）；否则不会注册任何工具。

description.en: A dsh plugin that enforces customizable guard rules on bash tool calls before the agent runs a bash command
description.zh: 在 agent 执行 bash 命令前先按自定义规则检查一遍，把危险操作拦下来，避免误删误改。

description.en: 大鲸鱼 / Big Whale / 大クジラ — a trilingual DSH desktop companion with lip sync, expressions, idle motions and context-compaction rice.
description.zh: 会眨眼、对口型、还会啃压缩米饭的三语桌面鲸鱼伙伴，陪你在 DSH 里写代码。

description.en: BMAD-Method 封装插件：在 dsh 内管理 BMAD 的全部模块与 skill
description.zh: 在 dsh 里统一管理 BMAD 的模块清单、开关和更新，不用来回折腾安装器。

description.en: Kanban board for DeepSeek Harness: tasks bound to long-lived native Sessions, live run status, and the Session's real conversation inside the board.
description.zh: 把任务做成看板卡片，每张卡绑定一个长期会话，运行状态和真实对话都能在板子上直接看。

description.en: 三本书，一副记性 —— 给 AI 的笔记本 / 工作本 / 日记本，全是 Markdown，零依赖
description.zh: 给 AI 配三本本地 Markdown 小本本，记笔记、记工作、写日记，零依赖不联网。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的 Breeze Blue 语音朗读插件：代理可朗读、回复一键播放、音色设计与 12 种情绪语气。
description.zh: 把 Breeze Blue 语音朗读接进 DSH，代理能朗读、回复一键播放，还能调音色和情绪语气。

description.en: Embed web AI (ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek) inside DeepSeek Harness: split layouts, read conversations, save markdown/images, ask with approval.
description.zh: 把 ChatGPT、Claude 等网页版 AI 嵌进 DSH 分屏，能读对话、存 Markdown 和图片，经你批准还能替你提问。

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web GUI plugin: a CDP-driven live browser view in the right sidebar - agent tools, human input relay, and low-latency WebRTC DataChannel frames
description.zh: 在右侧边栏实时查看浏览器画面，支持智能体操作、人工接管和低延迟画面传输。

description.en: Keep the BrowserSkill bsk daemon on-demand inside DeepSeek Harness - and fix the Windows "os error 5" that stops it from starting at all.
description.zh: 让 BrowserSkill 的 bsk 守护进程在 DSH 里按需启动、空闲退出，并顺手修好 Windows 上启动不了的 os error 5。

description.en: DSH 中控台：把活派给 CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy，自己验收，不合格打回同一会话返工；跨设备识别 + 一键部署。Supervised local-agent dispatch for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 把活派给 CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy，自己验收，不合格带意见打回同一会话返工，还能跨设备识别和一键部署。

description.en: CET-4/CET-6 vocabulary trainer for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: floating draggable word cards, spaced repetition, quiz mode with confusable distractors. 四六级背单词悬浮窗
description.zh: 四六级背单词悬浮窗，随时拖出来刷词，带间隔复习和易混词测验。

description.en: DSH 插件：cheer 工具 + 礼炮彩带效果（V0.1-Unstable，实验性）
description.zh: 模型一调用，网页两侧礼炮就朝中间喷彩带，纯画面无文字，给对话加点庆祝氛围。

description.en: DSH 本地部署优化插件：按时段/工作区自动切模型、预设匹配、会话续接、SurfCore 人设与记忆分级，本地失败自动回落在线。新手作品，AI 协助写成，欢迎大佬接手重构维护。| DSH plugin for local-LLM setups: time/workspace model routing, preset matching, session continuation. Beginner-made, AI-assisted; maintainers welcome.
description.zh: 本地大模型部署优化插件，按时段和工作区自动切模型、续接会话，本地失败自动回落在线。

description.en: DSH sidebar button that opens the classic (DS-Bot-free) Harness profile in Safari, starting it when needed.
description.zh: 在侧边栏加个 Classic mode 按钮，一键启动无 DS Bot 的经典版 Harness 并在 Safari 打开。

description.en: Claude 风格的 DSH Web 界面皮肤（fork 自 PAKIKNOWLEDGE/dsh-client-ui-skin-claude）
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 界面换上 Claude 风格皮肤，暖黑配陶橙，还能切换 Anthropic 字体，自动跟随亮暗主题。

description.en: Make the DeepSeek Harness desktop window close button quit the app instead of hiding to the tray, as a Settings -> General toggle. Byte-size-neutral app.asar patch plus a Cordis plugin.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端的关闭按钮真正退出应用，不再只是缩到托盘，可在设置里随时切换。

description.en: Codex 风格会话样式：轮次分隔线 + 右侧输入卡片（DSH Web 插件）
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页会话加轮次分隔线和用户输入卡片，长对话里一眼看清每轮从哪开始。

description.en: Conversational image generation for DeepSeek Harness, backed by your local ComfyUI.
description.zh: 在对话里说想画什么，插件就调用你本机 ComfyUI 出图，不联网也不用 API key。

description.en: 接管上下文压缩：手动与自动压缩均支持模型压缩和机械折页压缩。模型压缩支持备用模型兜底或直接使用备用模型；机械折页压缩速度快、不消耗 token、可溯洄，算法取自 dsh-ledger-compact。
description.zh: 把独立压缩模型和本地机械折页合到一起，按需选用，帮会话省上下文、控成本。

description.en: Deterministic compaction backend for DeepSeek Harness — zero-LLM, byte-deterministic summaries with verbatim anchors
description.zh: 把 DSH 的上下文压缩换成零 LLM 的确定性规则管线，毫秒出摘要、字节级可复现，不再担心事实漂移。

description.en: QQ 官方机器人专用的 DeepSeek Harness 伙伴插件：独立记忆、图片、视频抽帧、本地语音
description.zh: 让 QQ 官方机器人接入 DeepSeek Harness，自带独立记忆，还能看图、抽视频帧、本地语音聊天。

description.en: Mobile watchdog for the DSH web GUI: reload once when the composer is left broken after the app returns from background
description.zh: 手机端 DSH 网页从后台回来输入栏坏了就自动刷新一次，省得手动折腾。

description.en: Accessibility-first browser tools and experimental macOS desktop control for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 能操作浏览器和 macOS 桌面，自动完成点击、输入等任务。

description.en: Sync a DeepSeek Harness profile configuration across devices through Nutstore WebDAV or GitHub: per-file hash merge, conflict copies, optional AES-256-GCM encryption, settings-page UI.
description.zh: 把 DSH 配置通过坚果云 WebDAV 或 GitHub 同步到多台设备，冲突时两份都留，还能加密。

description.en: 魔搭社区（ModelScope）provider for DeepSeek Harness：对话栏显示剩余魔粒，设置页填令牌、勾选模型
description.zh: 把魔搭社区接入 DeepSeek Harness，对话栏实时显示剩余魔粒，设置页填令牌、勾选模型即可用。

description.en: 宪法可视化：上下文构成一屏看——截断探针（宪法文件多深度标记可见性自检·死区条款禁凭残页背书）+注入边界（自动注入面/按需拉取面）+总纲令体检（常驻令在位与字节量），与宪法种子一注入一验收成对
description.zh: 一屏看清 AI 上下文构成，检查宪法截断、注入边界和常驻令是否在位，避免把残页当全文。

description.en: Watches the context budget of a DeepSeek Harness session: a colour dot in every turn footer (green <50%, yellow 50-65%, orange 65-80%, red >=80%) read from the official contextPressure projection, a reminder panel with a one-click new-session handoff at orange/red, the /context-watch and /handoff commands, and a static reasoning-rule prompt section. Budget and handoff read local session files only; the badge and reminder spend no tokens until the button is clicked.
description.zh: 看护 DeepSeek Harness 会话的上下文预算：每轮回复底部一个颜色点（绿<50%、黄50-65%、橙65-80%、红≥80%，读官方 contextPressure 投影），橙/红档在输入框下方出现提醒与「一键开新会话」交接按钮，另有 /context-watch 与 /handoff 命令和一个静态思考规则提示段。预算与交接只读本地会话文件，徽章和提醒不点按钮不花 token。
会话撞上模型上下文窗口上限时紧急救援，帮你压缩上下文、救回卡住的对话。

description.en: Import a local Codex conversation thread into a DeepSeek Harness Session, filed under its original working directory, with optional auto-sync.
description.zh: 把本地 Codex 对话导入 DeepSeek Harness 会话，按原工作目录归档，还能自动同步，接着聊不费劲。

description.en: 在 DSH「Token 用量」弹窗里加费用/时段/倒计时三行，按 DeepSeek 官方价目表与峰谷计价
description.zh: 在 Token 用量弹窗里直接算出这场会话花了多少人民币，按官方价目表和峰谷时段计价。
